name: Red Cloud Banner (Xích Hà Kỳ)
lore: Xích Thành Môn's war banner, woven in 260 from fire-silk reeled at the vents (C068). Phượng Minh took it in 590 (C119) and hung it in the Hall of Spoils. In 1020 the founder lent it to the young Hùng Phần Vũ (C177). Its red has faded to the colour of a cooling coal. The palace treasurer Vưu Cẩm Thư has asked for it back three times. Hùng carries it into the vent at every first sitting, so that the new disciple sits under it.
build_use: A war banner for the hall's levy: Fire fury on the wearer and one rising.

name: Cinder Knuckle (Tẫn Quyền Hoàn)
lore: A heavy ring of red Đan Thạch stone set in iron, worn on the fist. Tào Tẫn Kiên ground it himself from a stone he carried out of the vent the day Hùng made him an elder, and it has been in more fights than he has admitted to.
build_use: The first elder's brawling ring: physical blows, a body shield, a little Fire.

name: Hide Tempered in Moving Fire (Lưu Hỏa Bì Giáp)
lore: A hide jerkin he wore into the vent the day the palace founder watched him stand in moving fire for an hour (C177). It came out black and has never burned since.
build_use: Stands in the lava: health, body shield and Fire resistance.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Cradle Feather (Hồng Vũ Ngọc Bội)
lore: The red feather the docks say fell on his cradle in Ngũ Thải Thành (A309), set in a cage of vent iron.
build_use: The heat the body gives back: fist and Fire damage.

name: Sitting-Stone Mail (Tọa Thạch Giáp)
lore: Plates of the red vent stone the sitters sit on, sewn onto leather. Every disciple he has brought out of the vent has touched it for luck.
build_use: The shield that lets you burn yourself out on him.

name: Weiqi-Board Shield (Kỳ Bàn Thuẫn)
lore: A square shield of stone cut with nineteen lines each way, the board he plays the palace's clerks on. He has never lost a game on it at the Fire Court.
